    From our small-town workshops to you

    We collaborate with a dozen small generational workshops in Donghai, where crystal carving craftsmanship has been passed down for decades.

    • Our craftsmen carefully select large natural crystals and carving stones.
    • The crystal is carved into shape using precision models and traditional techniques.
    • Each piece is polished by hand to reveal its natural clarity and shine.
